scope: POST_TAG; RFC-0005 §13 operator-only actions (HumanAuthorityGates). No machine edge holds this authority; the crown never performs them.

actions.title: Protect main
verification: gh api repos/seanchatmangpt/chatman-ecosystem/branches/main/protection --jq '{enforce_admins: .enforce_admins.enabled, force: .allow_force_pushes.enabled, deletions: .allow_deletions.enabled, reviews: .required_pull_request_reviews.required_approving_review_count}'   # expect: true,false,false,0

actions.title: Require a reviewer on the release-crown environment, protected branches only
verification: gh api repos/seanchatmangpt/chatman-ecosystem/environments/release-crown --jq '[.protection_rules[] | select(.type=="required_reviewers") | .reviewers | length] | add'   # expect: >= 1
python3 scripts/observe_governance.py --repo seanchatmangpt/chatman-ecosystem --out .artifacts/governance.json   # GET-only; then the autonomic job reports authority AUTHORIZED only if both hold

note: protected_branches=true requires main to be protected first (OA-01 before OA-02). Neither action changes the autonomy standing (a HumanAuthorityGate does not break U); both are required for authority AUTHORIZED and for U-08.
